verdict.description: REJECTED if there is at least one finding with severity BLOCKER. Otherwise APPROVED.

summary.description: Two to four sentences on the state of the plan.

severity.description: BLOCKER = implementing it as written produces wrong code, breaks a contract, or does not meet the spec. RISK = likely rework. NOTE = improvement.

where.description: Task N / Step M of the plan, or section.

evidence.description: REQUIRED: file:line in the repo, or a literal quote from the spec/plan. A finding without verifiable evidence must be downgraded to NOTE.

fix.description: What to change in the plan, concretely.

mechanical_checks.description: One entry per check executed with grep/reading in the repo.

command.description: The search/read tool call (or command) actually made.

spec_promises_without_task.description: Verbs/objects of the spec that no task covers. Empty if all are covered.
